posts.title: Setting Up FreeRADIUS with Google Workspace Authentication, VLAN Support per Client, and SSL Authentication
posts.description: Authenticate Wi-Fi users against Google Workspace with FreeRADIUS: Secure LDAP across multiple domains, per-office and per-group VLAN assignment, EAP over TLS, and access points on dynamic IPs verified through authoritative DNS.

posts.title: Google Family Link exploit that locks out victims permanently
posts.description: Imagine waking up to an alert that your Google Account password has been changed. You haven’t been standard-hacked. You’ve been trapped in the Family Link Exploit, a severe security loophole that weaponizes Google’s child safety features against adult users, and currently leaves victims completely stranded.

posts.title: MySQL Tips and Tricks
posts.description: Welcome to this practical guide filled with MySQL tips and tricks! Whether you’re a seasoned database administrator or just getting started with MySQL, these handy queries and techniques will help you manage your databases more efficiently.
